Interface MethodWatchRequest<A extends Annotation>

Type Parameters:
A - The annotation type
public interface MethodWatchRequest<A extends Annotation>
A request to watch the executable methods carrying an annotation, directly or as a stereotype: those of every bean, started with WatchableBeanContext.methods(Class), or those of the definitions a DefinitionWatchRequest selected, continued with DefinitionWatchRequest.methods(Class). It is the reload-aware form of an ExecutableMethodProcessor: the watch receives the methods present as its first batch, then one batch per change, which pairs a method with its new generation. 
context.methods(Scheduled.class)
    .onAdded(method -> schedule(method))
    .onRemoved(method -> cancel(method))
    .onReplaced(replacement -> reschedule(replacement))
    .watch();

Each terminal operation takes a snapshot of the request, so a request may be reused for further watches.

Since:
5.3.0

  • Method Details

    • onAdded

      MethodWatchRequest<A> onAdded(Consumer<? super BeanExecutableMethod<A>> handler)
      Adds a handler called with each method added, once the batch that adds it is applied. For the first batch, it is called with every method selected.
      Parameters:
      handler - The handler
      Returns:
      This request

    • onRemoved

      MethodWatchRequest<A> onRemoved(Consumer<? super BeanExecutableMethod<A>> handler)
      Adds a handler called with each method removed, once the batch that removes it is applied. A method replaced by a new generation of itself is given to onReplaced(Consumer) instead, when there is such a handler.
      Parameters:
      handler - The handler
      Returns:
      This request

    • onReplaced

      MethodWatchRequest<A> onReplaced(Consumer<? super ExecutableMethodChange.Replacement<A>> handler)
      Adds a handler called with each method removed and added again as a new generation of the same method: the same bean, name and parameter types. Without this handler, the method is given to onRemoved(Consumer) and its replacement to onAdded(Consumer).
      Parameters:
      handler - The handler
      Returns:
      This request
